name: Smatf
summary: This EA uses a multi-timeframe scoring system based on 5 SMAs (periods 5,8,13,21,34) across 3 timeframes and the Accelerator Oscillator to generate buy/sell signals. Each indicator contributes a score, and positions are opened when the aggregate score exceeds configurable thresholds. It includes stop loss, take profit, trailing stop, and basic position management.
summary_zh: 该EA使用基于3个时间周期上5条SMA（周期5、8、13、21、34）和加速振荡器的多周期评分系统来生成买卖信号。每个指标贡献一个分数，当综合评分超过可配置阈值时开仓。包含止损、止盈、追踪止损和基本仓位管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是综合多时间周期多均线方向与加速振荡器的评分系统。入场条件为：三个时间周期（M15、H1、H4）的上涨评分或下跌评分均超过50（OpenLevel=0时）则开仓，超过75则为强信号。每个时间周期中，5条SMA若当前值大于前值则贡献1分（上涨），反之为0分；AC指标若符合特定连续递增/递减模式则贡献3分，总分乘以12.5得到百分比评分。出场条件为：反向评分超过CloseLevel阈值时平仓，也可设置止损止盈出场。仓位管理采用固定手数（默认0.1手），无动态调仓机制。资金管理方面缺乏风控逻辑，无最大回撤限制或账户权益保护机制。追踪止损功能仅在价格超过开仓价后才开始生效，属于保本型追踪。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a multi-timeframe, multi-moving-average scoring system combined with the Accelerator Oscillator. Entry conditions require that all three timeframes (M15, H1, H4) show directional consensus — the aggregate up-score or down-score must exceed 50 on each timeframe simultaneously, with scores above 75 indicating stronger signals. Within each timeframe, 5 SMAs each contribute 1 point if rising (current > previous), and the AC indicator contributes 3 points if it shows a specific sequential momentum pattern, with the total multiplied by 12.5 to produce a percentage. Exit conditions trigger when the opposite-direction score exceeds the CloseLevel threshold, or via fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (default 0.1) with no dynamic adjustment based on equity or volatility. Money management is essentially absent — there is no drawdown limit, no equity protection, and no lot-scaling logic. The trailing stop only activates after price moves beyond the open price, functioning as a breakeven-style trailing mechanism.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: 指标检查的K线偏移（0=当前K线，1=已完成的K线）

parameters.name: CloseLevel
parameters.description: 平仓信号阈值（0或1，2=关闭平仓信号）
parameters.description_en: Close signal threshold (0 or 1, 2=disable close signal)

parameters.name: Trailing
parameters.description: 追踪止损点数（0=关闭追踪）

pros: 多时间周期共识机制降低了假信号概率，三个周期同向才开仓
评分系统设计合理，将多个指标方向量化为百分比便于理解
使用已成形K线（Shift=1）判断信号，避免当前K线变化导致的信号闪烁
包含止损止盈和追踪止损，提供基本风险控制手段
pros_en: Multi-timeframe consensus mechanism reduces false signals by requiring all three timeframes to align
Well-designed scoring system quantifies multiple indicator directions into an intuitive percentage
Uses confirmed bars (Shift=1) for signal evaluation, avoiding signal flickering on the current bar
Includes stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop providing basic risk control
cons: 代码结构极度冗余，大量重复的全局变量和if-else判断可用循环和数组替代
固定手数无资金管理，不根据账户余额或波动率调整仓位
止损止盈使用点数而非ATR动态计算，在不同波动率环境下可能不适配
追踪止损仅在盈利超过开仓价后触发，缺乏亏损时的保护机制
SolveLots函数实际上是空壳，未实现任何有意义的仓位计算逻辑
cons_en: Extremely redundant code structure with massive duplication — global variables and repetitive if-else blocks could be replaced by loops and arrays
Fixed lot sizing with no money management — no adjustment based on account equity or volatility
Stop loss and take profit use fixed points instead of ATR-based dynamic calculation, which may be unsuitable across different volatility environments
Trailing stop only activates after price exceeds the open price, lacking protection during losing phases
The SolveLots function is essentially an empty shell with no meaningful position sizing logic implemented
improvements: 用数组和循环替代大量重复的全局变量和if-else代码块，大幅提升可读性和可维护性
实现基于账户余额或ATR波动的动态仓位管理，替代当前的固定手数方案
增加最大回撤限制、最大同时持仓数和日内亏损限制等资金管理保护机制
improvements_en: Replace the massive number of redundant global variables and repetitive if-else blocks with arrays and loops to dramatically improve readability and maintainability
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity or ATR volatility instead of the current fixed lot approach
Add money management safeguards such as maximum drawdown limits, maximum simultaneous positions, and daily loss limits

risk_points: 固定手数无资金管理，在连续亏损时无法自动缩减仓位
SolveLots函数为空壳，名为'根据交易结果确定手数'但实际未实现
止损止盈使用固定点数，在高波动品种上550点可能过小导致频繁止损
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing with no money management means positions cannot be automatically reduced during consecutive losses
The SolveLots function is an empty shell — named 'define lot by trade result' but implements nothing
Fixed-point stop loss/take profit of 550 points may be too tight on volatile instruments, causing frequent stop-outs
